title: Front fence or wall maximum height 1.8 m
text: When provided, fences or walls within the primary street setback area are to be: i. a maximum height of 1.8m; and ii. visually permeable above 1.2m (refer Figure 3.6b); iii. measured from natural ground level on the primary street side of the fence or wall.

replaces.note: Part B had no overall height cap; pillars 400 -> 450 mm (relaxed)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Height measured from NGL on the primary street side (limb iii). R100-SL is a separate rule (900 mm, Table 2.10a). New 1.8 m cap for R40 and below. C3.6.5 cannot be varied by LPP/LDP without WAPC approval (Ch1 Tables 2.5A/2.5B). Secondary street fencing provision (Part C C3.6.9) deleted (ch2-074).
